text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Osaka Hai,
Red Desire put on a splendid performance.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Phew……―

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san's powerful running, and Buena-san's ultimate late-stage burst... But the one who bested them both was Desire-san...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"It's as if she's being guided by something...
If she has that running style, combining
tenacity and versatility..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... A "Saint," hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Red Desire's sharp and crisp stride, I'm certain.
The overseas race she should aim for is—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I think the BC would be a good choice.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To conquer America's tight corners,
in addition to good positioning and maneuvering,
an instantaneous burst of acceleration is essential.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Both seemed well-suited for Red Desire.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My...! For the two of you to be in complete agreement!
It's practically a sign from destiny...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
Journey-san, I am truly glad
I came to consult you as well...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please feel free to consult with me
when you actually embark on your away races.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I shall support you with all my heart and soul...
so that this journey may be truly wonderful, like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Let's set our sights on the BC!"
I need to let Vodka know right away――!
choice_data_list: Were you able to meet up with Vodka after that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Vodka didn't show up to the Osaka Hai,
and after that, she hadn't appeared before me either.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...No.
I'm sure they're just busy right now."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I'll send you a brief report.
That way, you can take a look whenever you have time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, no reply came from Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's situation
would soon come to light shortly after—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! You actually came?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Geez... "Quiet in the hospital," remember?
Well, not like I haven't been told that a bunch of times myself, though.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Is it true...
that the 'Crimson Wedge' has relapsed...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And so... because of that—...
—...gh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Vodka, who had a nosebleed during last year's summer camp, began showing the exact same symptom again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—it was decided that she would enter long-term medical care.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Now that it's the second time,
looks like I can't just take a quick breather
and hop straight into the next race, ya know?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
As for when I'll make my comeback,
I don't have a clue at all yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though,
a swordsman collapsing while coughing up blood is sick, right?
It gives off total 'legendary badass' vibes!”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Don't give me that look, Desire.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What a pain in the neck you are, Saintess-sama.
Let's step outside and talk for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Desire. I saw your message.
You've decided to take on the 'BC', right?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah.
Now that you've picked your goal, all that's left is to run!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
But... that's...!
I...—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Back on that day...!
Even though I swore to conquer the world alongside you...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This path only opened up because of you!
Going forward alone, without you, I just can't—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ......Truth is,

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm beyond frustrated too.
So frustrated that... words can't even describe it."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...I wanted to take on the world
together with you, too."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And then I wanted to conquer the world and become the coolest person in the whole wide world!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But... it's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: For now, at least.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Listen well, Desire.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I will never, ever give up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Because giving up...
is the absolute lamest thing you could ever do!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Go on ahead, Desire! Don't you dare let those legs stop!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'll catch up to you in no time, so go tear it up on the world stage for both of us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After taking Vodka to the hospital,
I returned to Red Desire—
who was offering a quiet prayer up to the night sky.
choice_data_list: Have you made up your mind?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am...—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I won't give up either...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens,
I'll keep running without ever falling to my knees—
for the sake of my desire!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I'm setting my sights on the 'BC'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Our target has been set on the autumn ‘BC.’
However, before that, I must make sure to compete in some high-level races.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Please, bestow upon me my next ordeal.
choice_data_list: For our next race... let's go with the Victoria Mile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista is running in this race as well.
Among race fans, there is great anticipation for a rematch
between the two after their Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, this race is the most fitting stage
for Red Desire to shine and take the spotlight."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... the Victoria Mile is also the race
that Vodka won last year.
—It was more than enough to feel guided by fate.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I will run this path to the very end.
A road that will eventually reach the far edge of the sea...!"
